值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解《劍星》在 Switch 移植版上的運行效能，包括幀率生成技術所帶來的輸入延遲與畫面妥協。
  • 全面解析結合《尼爾》美學氛圍與《隻狼》打擊節奏的核心戰鬥系統與機制特色。
  • 掌握遊戲豐富的服裝收集要素，以及與《尼爾》、《勝利女神：妮姬》及《蓓優妮塔》等知名作品的聯名內容詳情。

摘要

Switch 移植版的效能與手感評析

作者分享了《劍星》Switch 完整版的實際體驗，並建議玩家若有條件應優先考慮其他平台。雖然本作內容完整且處於可玩狀態，但在開啟幀率生成（Frame Generation）功能時，底層 30fps 插幀至 60fps 會產生嚴重的輸入延遲，這對極度仰賴精準彈刀與閃避的動作遊戲而言影響巨大。若將該功能關閉，幀率則在 30 至 45fps 之間波動，操作手感雖大幅改善，但在電視模式下的幀率不穩定感相對明顯；相對地，掌機模式受惠於小螢幕與 VRR 支援，關閉插幀後的體驗更為平順。

在視覺表現方面，Switch 版在植被、貼圖細節以及主角髮絲動態上均有所縮減，鏡頭快速晃動時也容易產生畫面偽影。作者認為，雖然完整版內建多國語音、體感震動與友善的輔助調整，但若能提供鎖定 40fps 的效能模式，會比現行在「高延遲的流暢」與「不穩定的幀率」之間二選一更切合動作玩家的需求。

融合《尼爾》與《隻狼》特質的戰鬥設計

回歸遊戲本體，作者指出《劍星》在美術與氛圍上帶有濃厚的《尼爾：自動人形》風格，空靈優美的人聲配樂在戰鬥中極具感染力。戰鬥系統則汲取了類似《隻狼》的硬核博弈感，其核心建立在完美格擋、完美閃避、閃現與擊退等機制上。敵人具備特殊的平衡值計量條，玩家透過連續精準格擋使其失衡後，便能施展高傷害的懲罰處決。隨著技能點數與裝備詞條的累積，格擋與閃避的判定窗口會更為寬容，多樣化的首領攻擊節奏也讓反擊反饋十分暢快。

地圖探索與豐富的服裝聯名內容

除了緊湊的戰鬥，遊戲在線性關卡外還開闢了荒野與大沙漠等大型沙盒地圖，融入平台跳躍、解謎與支線任務。作者特別提到，將大量的外觀服裝收集深植於探索循環中是本作的核心賣點之一。遊戲不僅收錄豐富的原創服裝，後續更新與 DLC 更包含了《尼爾》、《勝利女神：妮姬》以及免費的《蓓優妮塔》聯名外觀，透過完成數據收集或射擊小遊戲等具挑戰性的任務來獲取外觀，大幅拓展了遊戲的可玩性與視覺享受。

================================================

Hello, dear viewers, and welcome back to my channel. To be honest, I never imagined I’d find myself making another video about Stellar Blade. After all, it’s been over two years since the PS5 release. Not only did they launch a PC version, but the developers have been busy rolling out new costumes, Chinese voice-overs, and paid DLCs featuring NieR: Automata and Goddess of Victory: Nikke. I originally thought the main content of this game was wrapped up, but now, alongside the free Bayonetta costume update, a complete Switch version bundling all previous content has arrived as well. I’ll skip the online demo impressions and jump straight into my experience with the final release. My personal advice: if. you're interested, it’s best to choose other platforms. If you absolutely must get the physical Switch version, you should at least be aware of a few issues with this port. It is definitely playable, but at least in its current state, there are some aspects that noticeably impact the gameplay experience. First is the game's fluidity ; in the final release, you can toggle frame generation on or off in the settings at any time. With it on, the game maintains a steady frame output most of the time. However, in maps with complex scenes, you'll easily notice significant, sudden frame rate drops, especially when turning the camera quickly or exploring large sandboxes like the Wasteland and the Desert. For an action-combat-focused game like this.

, fluidity is crucial when enabling frame generation. While I find these fluctuations tolerable, there is a fatal issue: input lag. Based on a rough technical assessment, the game uses FSR 3 frame generation to interpolate a 30fps base image up to 60fps. When discussing Switch port optimization before, I pointed out that even games like Dragon Quest Monsters 3 suffer from input lag when frame generation is enabled. But that game has a slower pace and doesn't usually demand precise input . Stellar Blade is a different story; mechanics like perfect dodges and consecutive parries are essential, and the map exploration includes quite a few platforming segments. "Rurouni Kenshin" already has a fairly noticeable input buffer, and with frame generation turned on, you have to predict your moves even further ahead. For a game that requires frequent, precise inputs, the visuals may look smooth, but the actual button response lags behind. This disconnect, which persists throughout the entire experience, becomes particularly glaring , and frame generation can sometimes cause instability in the image quality during intense scenes. When turned off, the game’s frame rate hovers between 30 and 45 fps, making the controls feel much more responsive. However, since the actual frame rate fluctuates constantly based on scene complexity, these shifts and the resulting rhythm instability are more noticeable in docked mode. Conversely, in handheld mode, while the resolution is lower than in docked mode.

, the smaller screen size and support for VRR make playing with frame generation off feel more comfortable overall. Another point to consider is the visual presentation, which really comes down to personal preference. In my opinion, this issue is less critical than the trade-off between fluidity and input latency. As expected, the Switch version features scaled-back foliage and some environmental elements, along with lower-quality textures—all standard practices. In relatively static scenes and cutscenes, it actually looks decent , but once you start moving quickly with frame generation on, visual artifacts often appear, and some close-up shots can look quite blurry. Character hair being downgraded is common in these ports, but since Kenshin is the main focus, the long ponytail looks. lackluster, and the short ponytail, while it has a mind of its own when running, can be a bit hard on the eyes. Fortunately, you can choose to remove the ponytail or switch to other hairstyles, so this aspect is just a bit of a letdown in my view. As a complete edition, for players who haven't experienced it before and are interested , the replayability here is actually quite rich. It includes multi-language voice acting like Japanese and Korean, decent vibration feedback, support for motion controls, and highly detailed, user-friendly system settings. However, it fails to offer players more options for performance modes; for example, a relatively stable 40 fps would be more practical than the current choice between having frame generation—which adds latency—or not having it at all.

Since it’s primarily an action-adventure game focused on combat, there should be a better balance between the existing two options that suits action gameplay. Alright, let's move on to talking about the game itself. Stellar Blade was arguably the most "politically incorrect " game of the year, with its eye-catching heroine and an incredibly rich selection of outfits. Integrating costume collection into the core gameplay loop is definitely this title's biggest selling point. Moreover, with subsequent updates and some well-executed collaborations, this selling point has only continued to grow stronger. However, when it comes to the finer details compared to other major titles of the same genre, it still falls a bit short. Stellar Blade's gameplay is above average, and it feels remarkably similar to Nier in many aspects. Speaking of which, Nier just received official price cuts across all platforms this month, finally making up for a previous regret. Stellar Blade is an action-adventure game that, beyond combat, incorporates environmental exploration, platforming, and puzzle-solving elements. The story begins after human civilization has been devastated by mysterious creatures. As a member of an airborne squad, the protagonist is sent to reclaim Earth. As you progress, your squad gradually uncovers the truth about this world and humanity. While the story features plot twists, it's not as iconic as Nier's, but it holds up well in terms of atmosphere, music, and character design . For players who enjoy the Nier style, Nier: Automata is getting on in years,.

whereas Stellar Blade is much more up-to-date in its overall visual presentation and its standout character designs. Its music follows a similar path to Nier—melancholic backgrounds combined with beautiful, haunting vocals —which really sets the mood, especially during the main combat sequences. I previously described it as "Nier meets Sekiro," which might be a bit of an exaggeration, but the actual experience does capture a bit of that feel. Beyond basic attacks and combo strings, as you progress and spend skill points, you’ll unlock and upgrade various combat techniques like passive skills, burst skills, transformation states, and ranged attacks. But the core mechanics that truly define the combat system are the perfect parry, perfect dodge, blink. , and repulse. This type of setup has become quite common in many games recently. When enemies attack, players must react to visual cues at the right moment to perform the corresponding parries or dodges. Successful execution not only builds up energy but also allows for follow-up counterattacks. Some enemies have a balance gauge in addition to their health and armor bars . By performing perfect parries, you can break an enemy's balance and unleash a powerful retribution attack. There are quite a few combat mechanics in the game , but the overall system isn't actually that complex. Especially as you progress , players can use gear and skill points to make the windows for parries and perfect dodges much more forgiving. The boss design is another aspect I personally enjoy. Many bosses have.

distinct attack rhythms, and the satisfaction of blocking a series of enemy attacks followed by a counter is spot on. It's similar to Sekiro, where some attacks can only be avoided by dodging, jumping, or putting distance between you and the enemy; many late-game bosses frequently use these attacks that require specific responses . Beyond the hub area, the game features two larger, more open maps: the Wasteland and the Desert. Even in other more linear levels, there are plenty of hidden paths, collectible resources, gear, and costumes to find. On top of that, there are many side quests. These quests are only moderately fun, as a large portion are simple point-to-point tasks—either helping find items or going. to designated locations to defeat enemies, sometimes requiring a return to previously explored maps. However, the rewards are quite useful. Some side quests encourage you to explore areas outside the main path or open up new zones in previous maps, and there are even a few with branching narratives that are well-executed. Furthermore, thanks to subsequent updates and collaborations with NieR and Nikke, there are now quite a few new collectibles to find. This brings us to the game's most recognizable feature: the base game already includes a remarkably rich collection of outfits to unlock. Honestly, I don't really get into the technical side of it—I just watch others play and whatever they have equipped, that's what I see. What makes this game interesting is how it integrates massive outfit collection into the progression, encouraging you to.

carefully explore, complete specific side quests, and gather as much as possible. Some acquisition conditions are quite demanding, and the developers clearly have an eye for fashion; regardless, these outfits are all very pleasing to the eye, making the gameplay experience feel even better. This latest free collaboration with Bayonetta lets you obtain four outfits directly, while the previous NieR and Nikke collaborations required searching for mission objectives across the large Wasteland and Desert maps. For NieR, you have to complete a bunch of data collection tasks, while for Nikke, you play five shooting mini-games to trade for the corresponding skins. The developers put in a lot of effort; the NieR portion is very well-recreated in terms of character models, music, and original Easter eggs. The Nikke. collaboration changes up the mini-game style, though it features one very exciting boss fight. Additionally, completing the Boss Challenge mode will also reward you with corresponding outfits. A normal playthrough of this version, including side quests and collectibles, will take at least 20 to 30 hours or more. Unlike most completionist games that focus on challenging gameplay and a sense of achievement, the outfits here are purely for aesthetics. Collecting them all takes quite a bit of effort, but the harder they are to get, the better they look—it’s a form of positive reinforcement. In terms of the game's overall polish, Stellar Blade isn't exactly a masterpiece of innovation or gameplay depth, but it is a unique title with a distinct style. The story, combat.

system, level design, world exploration , and character portrayals are all decent, but they just never quite struck the right balance this time around. While the default motion blur setting can hit a 60 FPS output, there is a noticeable input lag during actual gameplay, yet turning it off makes it impossible to maintain a stable frame rate. For an action game that relies heavily on precise parrying, dodging, and rapid attacks, I feel this issue has a much greater impact on the actual experience than the visuals do. If you have already played it on PS5 or PC, I don’t think there is much need to double-dip for the Switch version, unless you really value the handheld experience, find the image quality acceptable, or want to collect the physical cartridge. If you haven't played Stellar Blade before, this. version is packed with content, but just be sure to keep the aforementioned issues in mind. Alright, that's it for today's video. Thanks for watching, and if you enjoyed it, don't forget to like and subscribe.

Stellar Blade's gameplay is above average, and it feels remarkably similar to Nier in many aspects. Speaking of which, Nier just received official price cuts across all platforms this month, finally making up for a previous regret. Stellar Blade is an action-adventure game that, beyond combat, incorporates environmental exploration, platforming, and puzzle-solving elements. The story begins after human civilization has been devastated by mysterious creatures. As a member of an airborne squad, the protagonist is sent to reclaim Earth. While the story features plot twists, it's not as iconic as Nier's, but it holds up well in terms of atmosphere, music, and character design . whereas Stellar Blade is much more up-to-date in its overall visual presentation and its standout character designs. 值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解《薩爾達傳說：時之笛》如何以創新設計奠定 3D 動作冒險的基礎。
  • 看見箱庭探索、神殿解謎與開放世界玩法之間的不同樂趣。
  • 掌握作者對重製版的評價，以及哪些玩家可能會喜歡這款作品。

摘要

經典作品的高分與歷史地位

作者從《薩爾達傳說：時之笛》重製版獲得媒體均分 96 分談起，探討這項成績究竟有多少情懷加成，以及作品是否真能經得起時間考驗。1998 年推出的原作以成熟的 3D 空間設計與「Z 鎖定」系統，為後來的動作冒險遊戲建立重要基礎。

時空、音樂與箱庭探索

遊戲透過林克在幼年與青年時期之間切換，讓玩家利用不同時空條件解開謎題；陶笛演奏也不只是音樂表現，更能改變環境、推動冒險。重製版翻新了畫面與音樂，並提供多種演奏方式，讓作品呈現更細緻的童話氛圍。

作者指出，本作的地圖採取彼此連結的箱庭式設計，不同於《曠野之息》與《王國之淚》的廣闊開放世界。它以區域、道具和機關細密串聯，讓玩家在逐步理解空間與解開線索後，獲得前後呼應的探索成就感。

神殿解謎與重製版評價

神殿是遊戲的核心挑戰之一，宛如大型立體謎題；戰鬥也重視觀察敵人弱點並善用道具，Boss 戰則融合多階段的判斷與解謎。影片提到的「薩爾達筆記」手機 App，還能提供冒險資料、地圖收集進度與提示，協助玩家在卡關時繼續前進。

作者認為，重製版並非單靠懷舊取勝，而是以現代的操作與視聽表現重新呈現經典設計。喜歡傳統箱庭探索與神殿解謎的玩家值得一試；若偏好高度自由的開放世界，則應先留意兩者的玩法差異。

開箱限定主機與外盒設計

作者收到香港版《薩爾達傳說》四十週年限定主機，準備進行尚未拆封的開箱。盒內附上的轉接插頭讓作者忍不住抱怨了一番，不過這台主機主要是收藏用途。外盒正面沒有封條，展示了底座、主機與限定 Joy-Con；包裝內部則大致與一般版相同。作者也提醒，這款限定主機並未附贈遊戲。

主機本體仍是一般版的黑色霧面外觀，作者認為若能加入薩爾達主題色彩會更有特色。限定圖樣帶有仿舊、磨損的歷史感，並延伸到支架等細節；圖案不反光，整體呈現沉穩質感。限定 Joy-Con 則是開箱重點：表面帶有金屬與珠光般的效果，觸感比作者預期更好，左側有三角力量標誌，搖桿周圍則飾以金色。裝上主機後，兩側綠色外觀相互呼應，背面的設計也十分出色。

item.itunes:author: Dio Chan
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4sNNwxvwxG4

值得閱讀的理由

  • 一次掌握 Nintendo Indie World 日美場次的多款獨立遊戲，快速了解各作品的玩法與特色。
  • 從解謎、卡牌策略到合作冒險與生活模擬，內容類型多元，方便讀者找到感興趣的作品。
  • 作者不只介紹遊戲內容，也點出適合的玩家族群，以及值得留意的合作、策略與探索元素。

摘要

解謎、卡牌與合作遊戲

作者介紹已推出的《Braid, Anniversary Edition》，這款由《Braid》與《The Witness》創作者帶來的解謎冒險遊戲，包含超過一千道手工設計謎題。玩家需要探索四個規則各異的世界，運用推箱子與特殊能力解開機關；隨著世界逐漸交疊，謎題也會融合不同機制，考驗玩家的思考與解題能力。

《One-Turn Kill》將牌組構築濃縮成一回合決勝：玩家以二十張卡牌組成牌組，設法在單次出手中擊倒敵人。《Super Chameleon》則是線上躲貓貓遊戲，躲藏者必須用顏色、圖案甚至姿勢融入場景；更新內容還加入新的團隊對戰規則、地圖與角色外觀。另一款輕鬆的清潔模擬遊戲讓玩家扮演可愛的大熊貓整理髒亂環境，並支援最多四人線上合作，搭配五十多首舒緩樂曲遊玩。

接著登場的是以「友情破壞」聞名的多人登山冒險：四名玩家扮演遭遇空難的探險者，必須在神祕山峰上互相協助、尋找離島方法。玩家要判斷落腳點、管理體力並善用道具，而混亂的物理效果與每日輪替地圖，可能讓隊友獲救，也可能讓人意外摔落。經典《都市傳說》也將登上 Switch，新增滑鼠風格操作與美術圖鑑，以復古畫風呈現都市怪談與詭異現象帶來的懸疑氣氛。

奇幻旅程與各式新玩法

《Sword of the Sea》是一款著重視覺與氛圍的冒險作品。神祕主角在古代遺跡甦醒後，將使用懸浮之劍高速穿越地形，尋找被掩埋的海洋、讓世界重獲生機；遊戲融合滑板、滑雪與衝浪般的移動感，並以美術與音樂營造奇幻景觀。另一款把任何事物都變成 Roguelike 的作品，則以推硬幣機為核心：玩家透過投幣達成各輪目標，取得額外硬幣、分數倍率或爆炸等效果，並搭配角色特性與道具打造連鎖反應，讓看似靠運氣的玩法也具有策略深度。

一款以日本桌遊平台為基礎的作品，支援最多四人共玩，收錄象棋、黑白棋、派對遊戲、TRPG 與推理遊戲等四十多種內容。它重視玩家互動與自由度，不會把所有規則都交由系統自動處理；不過日版伺服器目前似乎只有日文。接著介紹的悠閒生活遊戲以京都、青森、岐阜與別府為靈感，玩家要整理行李、規劃單車路線，替居民配送信件與包裹，並透過釣魚、打棒球、抓蟲、做壽司等活動認識小鎮居民，努力在夏季結束前重建神社、舉辦狸貓祭典。

《Spirit City》讓玩家來到連結人界與靈界的奇幻世界，探索、採集資源、協助迷途靈體，並與其他玩家交流或合作建造家園；隨著互動增加，遊戲還會逐步開放更多社交功能。《Goat Simulator》也將登上 Switch，玩家可以扮演山羊四處探索、完成任務或駕駛載具製造混亂，Switch 版改善了效能並收錄太空更新。節奏遊戲《Rhythm Doctor》則要求玩家配合病人的心跳進行手術，關卡會逐步加入錯拍、複雜拍號與複節奏等干擾，甚至用視覺效果誘使玩家按錯拍點；多元音樂與各關卡故事也增添了遊戲魅力。

生活模擬與更多值得關注的作品

《EvoCreo》融合生物進化與 Roguelike 元素，玩家透過進食累積經驗，選擇不同進化路線，讓每次遊玩都能嘗試新的組合。另一款受到生活模擬玩家期待的作品，乍看像《星露谷物語》，但舞台其實是魔法學院：主角來到海濱小鎮成為見習巫師，學習煉金術、占星與塔羅等知識，也能探索小鎮、結交居民、參加季節活動，或運用魔法經營小生意、協助居民。遊戲支援最多四人合作，既可獨自體驗學院生活，也能與朋友一同探索。

《Slime Rancher 2》延續前作的輕鬆魅力，玩家可在彩虹島探索古代科技與未知資源，收集各種史萊姆帶回牧場飼養，再用取得的材料升級設施、拓展探索範圍。最後，作者提到支援最多四人合作的浣熊模擬遊戲：玩家將和朋友扮演浣熊闖入人類領地，四處搗亂。影片在介紹這款作品時結束。

Hello, dear viewers, welcome back to my channel. I haven't even finished the last batch of new games, and now it's time for Nintendo's Indie World showcase . While there aren't any big first-party titles to headline, the platform is a great fit for indie games. Especially for players who enjoy handheld gaming, you can often find many hidden gems in these showcases. I've combined the content from both the Japanese and North American versions to walk you through them in the order of their release. Without further ado, let's get started. First up is the game already available on Switch, *Braid, Anniversary Edition* . It comes from the creators of*Braid* and*The Witness*, making it another puzzle-adventure that really tests your. brain. The most impressive part is that it includes over 1,000 hand-designed puzzles. Players must explore four distinct worlds with different rules, characters, and stories, using box-pushing and special abilities to solve various mechanical challenges. As the game progresses, these four unique worlds and characters begin to overlap, combining various puzzle mechanics and allowing you to develop new ways to approach gameplay you thought you'd already mastered—so don't underestimate it. The brilliance of this game lies in its puzzle design; for players who enjoy the sense of accomplishment that comes from figuring out solutions on their own , it holds a lot of appeal. Today's next. game has a title that explains its gameplay quite directly: *One-Turn Kill *. This title features retro pixel-art deck-building, but unlike standard card games, each battle lasts for only one turn. Players build a deck of 20 cards and must find a way to take the enemy out in one go. This essentially condenses the strategy and calculation of several turns in a traditional card game into a single burst of action, which should appeal to players who love studying deck builds and experimenting with combos. *Super Chameleon*is an online multiplayer hide-and-seek game where players are split into two teams. Here's the fun part: the hiders must.

manually paint themselves with various colors and patterns based on their surroundings to blend in just like a chameleon, even using poses to disguise themselves as objects in the scene. Whether you try to find a safe corner to hide in until the end or live dangerously by hiding in plain sight, it’s all up to your own creativity. This game was previously on Switch, and this update adds new team battle rules, maps , and character appearances. This could be considered a relaxing cleaning game— a casual simulation where you play as a cute giant panda, picking up cleaning tools to make messy environments neat and bright again. Moreover, you don't. just have to clean at your own pace; the game also supports up to four-player online co-op. You can enjoy the game's collection of over 50 slow-paced, relaxing tracks while cleaning alone, or invite friends to join in and see if you actually double your efficiency or just get in each other's way. This is the famous "break-up mountain climbing" game, a four-player co-op adventure where you play as a group of goofy-looking explorers who must reach the top of a mysterious peak after a plane crash to find a way off the island . The goal sounds simple, but the gameplay requires players to judge landing spots, manage stamina, and use. various items to help one another. Some maps rotate daily, and with the game's hilariously chaotic physics, when the moment of truth comes, whether you save your teammate or accidentally send them falling will really test your friendship . The classic "Urban Legend" game has now launched on Switch, adding new mouse-style controls, and an art gallery where you can view in-game scenes and previously unreleased character artwork . This is a suspense-adventure game centered on urban legends and bizarre phenomena. Beyond its eerie atmosphere, it features a highly distinctive art style that looks retro but excels in presentation and suspenseful vibes. "

Sword of the Sea" is a visually driven, atmospheric adventure game. You play as a mysterious protagonist who wakes up in an ancient ruin, using a hover-sword to zip across terrain at high speeds to find the buried ocean and restore life to the world. The game blends the feel of skating, snowboarding, and surfing, paired with a unique art style and music to explore its fantastic landscapes. Everything can be a roguelike—I wonder if any of you have played a coin-pusher machine before? The core goal of this game is to accumulate points by dropping coins to hit increasingly difficult targets in each round. As you push, you can acquire various special-effect coins. and items, such as extra coins, score multipliers, or even explosions that blast all the coins out of the machine at once. The game features different characters, each with their own unique coins and gameplay traits. You need to combine your coins and items strategically to trigger various effects . While it may look like it relies on luck, it actually offers plenty of depth for building and strategy, and it's incredibly satisfying to watch the coin explosions when chain reactions go off. This board game is based on a Japanese tabletop platform released for the Switch. One person can purchase it for up to four players to enjoy together, using the in-game chat to set up matches. . Beyond classics like chess and Othello , it includes various party games, TRPGs , and murder mystery titles, with over 40 games available at launch. What makes this title interesting is that it doesn't restrict all gameplay to rigid rules; instead, it offers significant freedom and emphasizes player interaction, as not every rule is automated by the system. However, the Japanese server version currently only appears to be in Japanese, though the visuals certainly capture that distinct summer vibe. The game is centered around four towns inspired by Kyoto, Aomori, Gifu, and Beppu, each with its own set of tasks waiting for you, the protagonist, to complete. Before setting off, the protagonist must pack parcels of different shapes, sizes, and weights.

into their backpack. You also have to plan your routes, figuring out how to use your bicycle to travel between these towns and deliver letters and packages to the residents, gradually getting to know everyone. You can also go fishing, play baseball, catch bugs, make sushi, or play the taiko drums. Use the money you earn and the materials you collect to rebuild the shrine before summer ends and host the annual Tanuki Festival. For players who enjoy life simulations and exploring small towns, or just want a relaxing game to enjoy while taking in the scenery, this is one to keep an eye on. Spirit City is also a life simulation game, but unlike typical single-player experiences, this title places a stronger emphasis on multiplayer online interaction. Players arrive in a fantastical land that. connects the human and spirit worlds, where they can explore, gather resources , and help lost spirits while interacting with other players. Meet others and work together to build your home. You can choose to avoid meeting others, or you can make friends and participate in various activities. As interactions between players increase, the game will gradually unlock more social features. Goat Simulator has arrived on the Switch, and it’s a hilarious game that kills physics engines. The Switch version features improved performance and also includes the space update. Rhythm Doctor is somewhat similar to. Rhythm Heaven, yet quite different, though both share the concept of simplified controls paired with imaginative level design. The visuals are also designed to trick you into pressing buttons at the wrong time, so even if you've mastered the music, it's easy to slip up. Each level has its own story, which, combined with diverse musical styles and creative level mechanics, makes it quite engaging. evolutionary paths, allowing you to try unique combinations in every run. This game is one that many fans of life simulation games have been waiting for quite a while. Rainbow Island is not only home to colorful, quirky slimes, but it also hides ancient technology, unknown resources, and plenty of secrets waiting to be discovered. Players can freely roam the island, collect different types of slimes to raise on their ranch, and use harvested resources to upgrade and expand, gradually widening their exploration. The game’s relaxed and vibrant atmosphere makes it a very chill experience. Raccoon Simulator, or rather "Troublemaker Simulator," supports up to four-player co-op. You and your friends play as raccoons, causing chaos in human. territory. You can raid trash cans, steal food, snatch all sorts of random items, or even break into houses to mess with anything your little paws can grab . Along the way, you'll have to complete all sorts of absurd missions. Once you cause enough of a stir, people will come to catch you, and balancing destruction with escaping capture is a big part of the fun. The visuals are super retro, using a Game Boy Color aesthetic combined with open-world exploration and RPG gameplay. The protagonist and their partner travel along the coast, exploring the city and meeting all sorts of interesting characters. You'll also get sidetracked by side quests and get to experience various mini-games. This game is currently available as a demo. If you like retro pixel art and want to.

play a relaxing RPG with exploration and story elements, you should give this a try. As for this game, the name is quite absurd, and the gameplay is even more so . The game is set in a city filled with spirit beasts and dangerous robots. Players will adventure through five unique areas, each with distinct environments, gameplay styles, and designs. mechanics designed around canine abilities, like sniffing out clues, digging up hidden items, or barking in emergencies. The game's environmental design is quite unique, featuring Japanese-style streets with torii gates , alongside neon signs and various buildings full of nostalgia; the lighting makes the world look both dreamlike and slightly eerie. In terms. of gameplay, players need to explore the island while lighting up shrines scattered throughout to illuminate the surroundings, uncovering new paths and hidden content, all while being wary of monsters lurking in the shadows. 一款以日本桌遊平台為基礎的作品，支援最多四人共玩，收錄象棋、黑白棋、派對遊戲、TRPG 與推理遊戲等四十多種內容。它重視玩家互動與自由度，不會把所有規則都交由系統自動處理；不過日版伺服器目前似乎只有日文。接著介紹的悠閒生活遊戲以京都、青森、岐阜與別府為靈感，玩家要整理行李、規劃單車路線，替居民配送信件與包裹，並透過釣魚、打棒球、抓蟲、做壽司等活動認識小鎮居民，努力在夏季結束前重建神社、舉辦狸貓祭典。

《Spirit City》讓玩家來到連結人界與靈界的奇幻世界，探索、採集資源、協助迷途靈體，並與其他玩家交流或合作建造家園；隨著互動增加，遊戲還會逐步開放更多社交功能。《Goat Simulator》也將登上 Switch，玩家可以扮演山羊四處探索、完成任務或駕駛載具製造混亂，Switch 版改善了效能並收錄太空更新。節奏遊戲《Rhythm Doctor》則要求玩家配合病人的心跳進行手術，關卡會逐步加入錯拍、複雜拍號與複節奏等干擾，甚至用視覺效果誘使玩家按錯拍點；多元音樂與各關卡故事也增添了遊戲魅力。

值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解SNK經典格鬥系列《餓狼傳說：群狼之城》在睽違二十餘年後的正統續作革新與現代化系統。
  • 掌握遊戲最新角色陣容、跨界聯動角色（如《快打旋風》、《北斗神拳》及《東京復仇者》）與季票擴充內容。
  • 解析REV系統、簡化操作機制及Switch 2版本帶來的跨平台對戰體驗與新手友善度。

摘要

經典格鬥系列的傳承與回歸

作者回顧了90年代街機廳的輝煌歲月，當時SNK旗下除了大名鼎鼎的《拳皇》，更有《侍魂》、《龍虎之拳》與誕生極早的《餓狼傳說》系列。自上一部《群狼之證》（狼之印記）推出後，該系列歷經二十多年的沉寂，如今終於迎來正統續作《餓狼傳說：群狼之城》。本作延續了虛構城市南鎮的故事背景，承接洛克等主角的新篇章，並非單純販賣情懷，而是將整體格鬥系統進行了細緻的現代化改造。

核心對戰機制與現代化操作

遊戲核心機制圍繞在SPG機制與全新的REV系統。REV系統將強化戰鬥思維貫穿整場對局，不僅能用於強化必殺技、銜接攻擊，亦可用於防守。然而持續使用會累積REV量表，一旦過熱便會陷入無法使用特殊技能且防禦脆弱的危險狀態，極為考驗玩家的資源管理與攻防立回能力。為了兼顧不同層次的受眾，本作同時提供能發揮全部性能的傳統街機操作與適合新手的一鍵必殺簡易模式，降低入門門檻。

龐大的聯動陣容與豐富單人內容

隨著遊戲登陸Switch 2並更新至第三彈季票，可用角色已突破30位。除了經典的泰瑞、安迪、東丈和不知火舞等角色回歸，還大幅展開跨界聯動，收錄了《快打旋風》的肯與春麗、《北斗神拳》的拳四郎，甚至連《東京復仇者》的佐野萬次郎與龍宮寺堅都參戰。此外，遊戲提供包含劇情分支的街機模式、RPG要素的單機挑戰與複製玩家風格的克隆AI模式，滿足不同遊玩取向。

跨平台對戰與作品總體評價

作者指出，Switch 2版本提供60幀流暢畫面並支援跨平台連線對戰，搭配豐富的角色季票，性價比極高。作者總結，《群狼之城》不僅喚醒了老玩家的街機記憶，更憑藉優秀的攻防博弈深度、現代化的操控設計與持續擴充的角色生態，證明這部老牌IP在現代格鬥遊戲市場中依舊具備強大的生命力與熱度。

遊戲核心機制圍繞在SPG機制與全新的REV系統。REV系統將強化戰鬥思維貫穿整場對局，不僅能用於強化必殺技、銜接攻擊，亦可用於防守。然而持續使用會累積REV量表，一旦過熱便會陷入無法使用特殊技能且防禦脆弱的危險狀態，極為考驗玩家的資源管理與攻防立回能力。為了兼顧不同層次的受眾，本作同時提供能發揮全部性能的傳統街機操作與適合新手的一鍵必殺簡易模式，降低入門門檻。

龐大的聯動陣容與豐富單人內容

隨著遊戲登陸Switch 2並更新至第三彈季票，可用角色已突破30位。除了經典的泰瑞、安迪、東丈和不知火舞等角色回歸，還大幅展開跨界聯動，收錄了《快打旋風》的肯與春麗、《北斗神拳》的拳四郎，甚至連《東京復仇者》的佐野萬次郎與龍宮寺堅都參戰。此外，遊戲提供包含劇情分支的街機模式、RPG要素的單機挑戰與複製玩家風格的克隆AI模式，滿足不同遊玩取向。

跨平台對戰與作品總體評價

作者指出，Switch 2版本提供60幀流暢畫面並支援跨平台連線對戰，搭配豐富的角色季票，性價比極高。作者總結，《群狼之城》不僅喚醒了老玩家的街機記憶，更憑藉優秀的攻防博弈深度、現代化的操控設計與持續擴充的角色生態，證明這部老牌IP在現代格鬥遊戲市場中依舊具備強大的生命力與熱度。
